I'm sorry, that's a frustrating way to lose two hours. I saved it to EngramDB as a high-priority hazard. Future sessions and anyone else working on this project will see it when they look at payment or config issues.

I couldn't find where the switch actually happens: `PAYMENTS_LIVE` doesn't appear anywhere in this repo. The only payments-related code here is the sandbox URL in `tests/test_payments.py:4` and the `integration` test marker in `pyproject.toml`. So the fallback probably lives in a dependency, deployment config, or a different package. The memory records that so nobody wastes time searching here.

If you can point me to where the gateway gets picked, I can make the fallback obvious so this doesn't catch the next person. For example, it could log a loud warning at startup when it uses the fake gateway, or refuse to start in production when `PAYMENTS_LIVE` isn't set.
